title: See budget futures side by side, in chat with Claude
description: Type your budget split and the thing that might change, and Claude draws three scenarios next to each other with a toggle between dollars and percentages.
prompt: We might lose our $400K federal grant next year. Current budget is about $2.1M: Roughly 60% programs, 25% ops, 15% fundraising. Show me three scenarios side by side: We lose the grant, we stay flat, it grows a bit. I want to flip between dollars and percentages, and if I click a scenario give me the one-line version of what it actually means.
steps: Describe the task (provide budget and the variable that might change)
Give Claude context (type numbers directly; rough estimates acceptable)
Claude creates visual output (three stacked bar charts with toggle and scenario descriptions)
Follow up with refinements (constraint buttons, multi-year timelines, board-ready language)
prerequisites: No file uploads required; works with manually entered numbers
Optional: Google Drive connection for real budget spreadsheets
